test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd199b7d54c0d92e6c26642f0cee44cdfd7278e40f0a8f77c809985b6275af53.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The diamond element shift diagonally back and forth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f3266560a920fd6968dd2754b283860a3452942b0ff4cb0f124eaed02ab211.png] 

2) Rectangle element shift to the opposite side and diagonally alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb82fb5a7d8fe42f400ac5701ea7d52915d0dd945d604d860bbdc815273b22f2.png] 

3) The cross element skip two places (one corner and one side) clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb7be8914ddad1b245cd4d82d5f2ca00a66f96a13af57081bbdad5d193f4de8b.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f48323c98629d77c876e3e6f8fb5c29bf55b4812e918e63ac013bc03c66fee4d.png] 

Hence, **‘option 4’** is the correct answer.
